description: v106: Fixes icon.svg quoting failure by using heredoc. Persists JSON fix list and database for LLM loop.

steps.name: Write icon.svg using heredoc to avoid nested quote escaping
steps.issue: run_step apply string with python3 -c and double quotes failed because eval stripped necessary escaping for SVG attributes. Result: SyntaxError 'unterminated string literal'.
steps.fix_applied: Replace the python3 -c command with a heredoc that writes the SVG content directly.

steps.name: Persist the JSON fix list as a text file in the repo
steps.issue: The fix list JSON must always be available for future self‑healing and the LLM loop.
steps.fix_applied: At script start, write the full v106 JSON to parachute-fixlist-v106.json.
